ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Text.helper: Enter the text for text. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

Class.helper: Choose the class from the available options.

AlternativeFont.helper: Enter the alternative font to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

TextWidthColor.helper: Enter the text width color to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Color.helper: Choose the color from the available options.

OtherText.helper: Enter the text for other text. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

fields.helper: Add and arrange the items used for fields. Remove any item you do not need.
